title: rathbunia chrysocarpa
intro: Rathbunia chrysocarpa, commonly known as Mountain Fleabane, is a flowering plant in the daisy family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and has been found to have several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Rathbunia chrysocarpa include soothing skin irritations and reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
